title: Facet Model Registry
description: Facts-first model registry table. Encoding rule: an ABSENT field is exactly null (unknown) — it is never filled with a default. Costs are USD per million tokens. Unknown fields must be ignored by consumers.

schema_version.description: Table schema version. Semantics of existing fields never change within a version; breaking changes bump this.

updated_at.description: Date the table was last generated (UTC).

generator.description: Tool name and version that generated the table.

modelFacts.description: Facts for one model. An ABSENT field is exactly null (unknown): it must never be filled with a default. Only 'provider' is mandatory. quality_hint is the only non-factual (subjective) field. Unknown extra fields must be ignored by consumers.

aliases.description: Alternative names, including aggregator channel naming (e.g. 'openai/gpt-4' -> 'gpt-4').

context_window.description: Maximum context window in tokens. Null when unknown.

max_output.description: Maximum single-response output tokens. Null when unknown.

reasoning.description: Is a reasoning model (or exposes reasoning options).

cost.description: Price in USD per million tokens. Other currencies/units are forbidden in the table.

quota_tier.description: Free-tier annotation for free model access. Maintained manually; sync never guesses it.

release_date.description: Model release date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when the day is unknown upstream), for freshness hints.

last_updated.description: Date the upstream record was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when the day is unknown).

quality_hint.description: Subjective quality prior (1-5). The ONLY non-factual field; consumers must be able to ignore it. Filled manually, never auto-generated.
